title: AskEIVA: AI Support Assistant for EIVA
short_desc: An AI assistant that helps EIVA's customer service team find answers fast, by searching the company's technical manuals and past support tickets.
blueprint_desc: I first built a quick prototype in Python to prove the idea worked. I then rebuilt it as a robust, long-lasting application in C# and .NET, where the business logic, the database and the user interface are kept apart — making it easier to test, extend and hand over. The finished platform has a web interface for chatting with the assistant, configuring it and checking the quality of its answers.
tech_notes: Successfully re-engineered a single-file Python prototype into a strictly decoupled C# Clean Architecture. By separating our core business logic from database boundaries, the system provides strict type-safety and background execution loops across four distinct layers (Domain, Application, Infrastructure with Weaviate vector operations, and a Blazor Interactive Server web interface).
